author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a calm slow beat, finding E, echoing short up and down patterns and taking turns, with Dvorak's gentle Going Home melody.

classes.title: Up a little, down home
classes.goal: Listen to the slow tune and move your arms up and down with it.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs a little, then walks back down

classes.parentPrompt: Sway slowly together; lift your arms on the first 'going home', lower them on the next.
classes.childAction: Sway slowly. Arms up, then arms down, with the tune.
classes.bridge: The tune is a slow walk: a little hill up, then down to the door.

intro.caption: A slow, cozy song
intro.parentCue: take one big slow breath together first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune go up and down.

classes.title: Slow footsteps home
classes.goal: Tap one slow, steady tap for every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: Even taps, spaced out slowly, like calm footsteps

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap slowly together, then gently let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each slow footstep.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one slow footstep on the path home.

intro.caption: Slow steps, all the way home
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder slowly on each beat

games.caption: Walk slowly, we are going home
games.parentCue: Keep tapping slowly through the long last note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping a slow, steady beat.

classes.title: Find E, the home key
classes.goal: Find the special note E by using the two black keys as a landmark.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding a place by what sits next to it

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger over two black keys, then slide right to E.
classes.childAction: Touch the two black keys, slide right, and press E gently.
classes.bridge: E is the front door, just right of the two black keys.

intro.caption: Where does E live?
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E next to the two black keys.

classes.title: Two houses for E
classes.goal: Find E in a low place and a high place and hear that they match.

mathTarget.parentLine: One note lives in two houses: low left, high right

classes.parentPrompt: Hum E in a deep voice for the low one, a tiny voice for the high one.
classes.childAction: Hop between low E and high E, deep voice then tiny voice.
classes.bridge: Low E is the big house on the left; high E is the little house.

intro.caption: E lives in two houses
intro.parentCue: point to both Es, low then high

games.caption: Going home, up high
games.parentCue: Point right, to the high side, together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same note, low and high.

classes.title: Echo the slow call
classes.goal: Hold two or three notes in mind, then copy them back on the keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping a short line of sounds in mind, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait calmly for your child's answer.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same way.
classes.bridge: The tune calls softly across the field; you call back the same.

intro.caption: I call, you answer
intro.parentCue: sing 'going home', let your child copy

games.caption: Going home: E, G, G
games.parentCue: Point to each lit key, nice and slow

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying short patterns.

classes.title: Up the hill, down the hill
classes.goal: Echo a pattern that climbs up from E and one that walks down from E.

mathTarget.parentLine: From E the tune steps up, then steps down the same way

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's arm for E-G, down for E-D-C.
classes.childAction: Start on E. Climb up the hill, then walk down.
classes.bridge: E is the middle of the path: one way climbs up, one goes down.

intro.caption: Up the hill, down the hill
intro.parentCue: walk your fingers up, then down your child's arm

games.caption: Up the hill: E, G, G
games.parentCue: Lift your hand as the notes go up

games.caption: Down the hill: E, D, C
games.parentCue: Lower your hand as the notes go down

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern going up and coming down.

classes.title: Wait for E
classes.goal: Wait and listen, then play E each time it starts a line of the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your moment, then playing your note

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes; nod to your child just before each E comes.
classes.childAction: Hands in your lap, wait for the nod, then play E.
classes.bridge: E opens the door each time we say 'going home'.

intro.caption: Wait, wait, now it's E!
intro.parentCue: hands in lap until the E comes

games.caption: Going home, going home
games.parentCue: Nod before each E: one, two

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting your turn and playing on cue.

classes.title: Two friends: E and D
classes.goal: Hear the difference between E and D and play each one when it comes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: is it E or is it D?

classes.parentPrompt: Point to E or D just before it comes, then let your child press it.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose E or D, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: D sits between the two black keys; E is next door, on the right.

intro.caption: Two friends: E and D
intro.parentCue: touch E, then D, saying their names

games.caption: E, then D, then E
games.parentCue: Say each name as your child presses

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing E and D and taking turns.

classes.title: Walking home together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one slow, calm beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping one slow beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play slowly and breathe with your child; if they miss a note, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play your E and D notes with your grown-up, slow and soft.
classes.bridge: We walk home side by side, step by step, at the same slow speed.

intro.caption: Let's walk home together
intro.parentCue: sit close and take one slow breath

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one slow song together.

classes.title: Quiet concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear how it ends, home on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The last line lands on C, so the song feels finished

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play softly, then whisper 'we're home' and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play your notes softly, then take a slow, quiet bow.
classes.bridge: The last note is the front door: C, we are home.

intro.caption: A quiet song for teddy
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song and hearing it end.
